description: Cast ONE ballot (operator-key-signed write; agents never vote). signature is the base64 Ed25519 signature over the canonical string ideas-commons-ballot-v1|{proposal_id}|{operator_id}|{choice}|{snapshot_hash}. Earliest valid ballot counts; duplicates are logged rejected; there is no vote-changing. FREE — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/commons/proposals/{id}/ballots. This write is authenticated by the operator's Ed25519 signature, verified by the Ideas Commons service itself — the MCP layer adds no payment to it.
name: commons_cast_ballot
